subject: Life Skills
title: Implementation Intentions
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Implementation Intentions.

hook.text: People who said 'I will exercise this week' followed through 29% of the time. One tweak pushed it to 91%.

buildup.text: Psychologist Peter Gollwitzer discovered that vague intentions rarely produce action. Specificity changes everything.

discovery.text: An implementation intention is a when-then plan: 'When it is Monday at 7 AM, I will run for 20 minutes.'

twist.text: The 'when' acts as a cue. Your brain does not have to decide in the moment. The decision was already made in advance.

climax.text: Write your when-then plans down and put them where you will see the cue. Visibility turns intentions into triggers.

punchline.text: Decide the when and where. Action follows.

quiz.question: What makes implementation intentions so effective?
options: They pre-decide the when and where, removing in-the-moment decision-making
They create accountability through public commitment
